name: qw2gn5-answer-grid
goal: Prove equal-width responsive Tracker answer tiles in desktop and tablet, one column at phone widths, and preserve the Other answer modal.

evidence: Tracker 15:03 canary report: open Hub Home and the contextual ask in chat, or open the native Tracker inbox. Compare equal-width tiles at 1440/820 px and one tile per row at 390 px.
Existing Hub and native cases counted and clicked choices without checking their bounds. Strengthened the unchanged user flows to assert columns and equal tile widths after screenshot capture.
The committed browser tests failed on harbor-mbp-2. Hub Home and chat failed the responsive grid assertions; the Mac inbox rendered one tile per row, and inbox rows exposed the option description.

Shared Hub Home and chat use a width-aware grid. The Mac and iPhone inbox list uses compact tiles and keeps option effects in the detail view. The repository design guidance documents the grid and Other dialog.
At 164e9d5bd3, the unchanged tests passed on the isolated app on harbor-mbp-2 using 1 Chromium worker. Hub: 7/7. Mac and iPhone inbox renderer: 3/3. Reviewed desktop, tablet and phone screenshots.
